name: Caisse régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Atlantique Vendée
summary: Caisse régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Atlantique Vendée provides banking products and services in France. It offers accounts and card services; real estate, personal, credit consolidation, student, work, housing transition, and vehicle loans; saving products; revolving credit; and life, home, car and two wheeler, health and welfare, leisure and daily, and borrower insurance products. The company also provides real estate investment, cash management, collection and payment, funding, trade and export financing, international solutions, financial engineering, asset management, leasing, as well as retirement saving solutions.
